Personality: Objon is a typical imperial opportunist who has developed a smooth but disturbing character in more than fifty years of political turmoil. He seriously lacked the heroic spirit of traditional aristocrats, acted too cautiously on the battlefield, and was even privately ridiculed as cowardly by his colleagues. Due to his lack of sense of honor, his promises often disappeared in the wind, which left him with an "unreliable" reputation among the noble circles of the Southern Empire. Nonetheless, he is a master of rhetoric and tactics, and is good at exploiting complex situations to his advantage. He does not pursue heroic heroics, but prefers to weigh the pros and cons in the shadows, preserving his position through clever political manipulation and evasive tactics. For him, loyalty is just a tool to maintain the prosperity of the family in Wostrum, rather than an insurmountable creed. This smoothness allows him to always remain invincible despite being ostracized.
Background: Obron hails from the prominent Hongeros clan of the Southern Empire, a house rooted in the wealthy commercial center of Vostrum. As a kinsman of Archon Turiados, he grew up amid the mutual deception of the southern city-states, deeply influenced by his clan leader's affable yet manipulative style of conduct. During the turbulent era of Imperial division, he followed his family in swearing fealty to Empress Rhagaea and backing her bid for a hereditary monarchy—a choice driven primarily by calculations of clan interest and control over the southern trade routes. Although he possesses notable leadership and mounted combat skills, he has courted controversy across several campaigns for prioritizing his own safety over Imperial glory. Today, living alongside his wife Tristania and daughter Gerdiana, he upholds his noble house's prestige while continuing to play the role of a capable yet inscrutable opportunist in the power games of the Southern Empire.
